market.question: Will the highest temperature in Chengdu be 23°C on April 30?

assessment.reasoning: April climatology for Chengdu has daily highs averaging around 22-24°C; recent forecasts indicate temperatures in the low-mid 20s°C around April 30. With one bin per integer °C, the 23°C bin is the modal outcome but adjacent bins (22 and 24) are about as likely. Market 0.30 looks roughly fair to slightly high.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Exact integer-°C bin and possible deviation from forecast on the day
